raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":2942,"db1":"MYSQL","query1":"SELECT v.mmsi FROM transportation.vessel v JOIN transportation.shipping_company sc ON v.company_id = sc.company_id WHERE sc.company_name = '长航集团'","db2":"POSTGRESQL","query2":"SELECT mmsi, ROUND(SUM(ST_Length(ST_Transform(ST_MakeLine(geom ORDER BY timestamp), 3857)))::numeric, 2) AS track_length_meters FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi IN (result) AND timestamp >= '2024-06-01 00:00:00' AND timestamp < '2024-06-02 00:00:00' AND geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(121.0, 31.0, 121.5, 31.5, 4326) GROUP BY mmsi"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"船舶所属公司为长航集团","tables":["MYSQL:transportation.vessel","MYSQL:transportation.shipping_company"],"columns":["mmsi","company_id","company_name"]},{"requirement":"2024年6月1日经过矩形区域(121.0,31.0)至(121.5,31.5)","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["mmsi","timestamp","geom"]},{"requirement":"返回船舶MMSI和在区域内的部分轨迹长度","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["mmsi","geom","timestamp"]}],"assumptions":["轨迹长度按船舶在矩形区域内的AIS点顺序连接后的折线长度计算，单位为米","公司名称精确匹配'长航集团'"]}
